_comment: Mock CVE reference dataset. In production, pull from NVD API (https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/data-feeds).

cve_hints.name: EternalBlue / WannaCry
cve_hints.description: SMBv1 remote code execution. Exploited globally by WannaCry ransomware in 2017.

cve_hints.name: BlueKeep
cve_hints.description: RDP pre-auth remote code execution on Windows 7/Server 2008.

cve_hints.name: Redis Lua RCE
cve_hints.description: Unauthenticated remote code execution via Lua sandbox escape in Redis.

cve_hints.name: MongoDB Auth Bypass
cve_hints.description: MongoDB 2.4.x allows authentication bypass in some configurations.

cve_hints.name: Cleartext Credentials
cve_hints.description: Telnet transmits all data unencrypted. Credentials are trivially interceptable.
